Mumbai Airport Flight Shift Deferred to March 2027

Adani Airport Holdings has deferred its plan to shift a portion of international flights from Mumbai to Navi Mumbai until the summer schedule begins on March 28, 2027. This decision follows a consultative meeting involving the Centre and airlines. Approximately 30% of Mumbai's international flight slots were slated for relocation.
